answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  SUM(s.gross_amount) AS gross_revenue,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE
  s.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  p.brand
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
